title: TEAM COMBO
why: His yes to the team combo in the 2 player DEMO. When both players get a kill within two seconds of each other and within about fifty metres, the second kill pays a team bonus of forty times the chain, to the team score, with a TEAM COMBO callout, a medal and a note. A kill is in one pair only, so the figure is paid once; pairs that follow inside two seconds make the chain longer, up to times five, and a longer gap starts it again. Both screens hold the same chain, drawn as a cyan ring just outside your own combo ring that drains over the two seconds, with TEAM and the chain beside it. The windows tell each other about every kill to do this. The 1 player DEMO is unchanged.
now: In the 2 player demo, kills by both players close together build a shared TEAM combo.
